metadata.source: European Parliament open data portal: the parliamentary_term of each plenary meeting (/meetings).
metadata.note: The date each Parliament first sat. Every part of the site that needs to know which Parliament a vote belongs to reads it from here: the index and its folds, the address of the minutes a record cites, the audit's window, the seat counts. scripts/fetch-sessions.mjs adds the next Parliament by itself, the first time the portal lists a plenary meeting of it.
